nodes.name: Selective dealloying of Al-Cu-Ti
nodes.procedure: A novel non-precious bimetallic Cu-Ti catalyst with a bimodal pore size distribution by selectively dealloying Al-Cu-Ti alloy precursor. The micropores resulted from a complete removal of the Al phase of Al-Cu-Ti precursor alloy. While the nanopores obtained by the removal of Al atoms in the Al2Cu phase.
nodes.source_text: Lu et al. developed a novel non-precious bimetallic Cu-Ti catalyst with a bimodal pore size distribution by selectively dealloying Al-Cu-Ti alloy precursor

nodes.name: Two-step dealloying for PdCuNi-S
nodes.procedure: Yang et al. developed a multicomponent nanoporous PdCuNi-S catalyst through a two-step dealloying method. The Al80Pd10Cu5Ni5 precursor was dealloyed in KOH solution to obtain nanoporous PdCuNi intermediate, and then was immersed in H2SO4 solution to obtain nanoporous PdCuNi-S catalyst.
